name: Guess the Slapper
desc:
One person sits 🪑 while everyone else stands behind them... 👥
Everyone takes turns slapping 👋 the sitting person until they guess who slapped them... 🤔
If you react quick enough, you can dodge the incoming slap! 👋💨😱
Last One Standing Wins! 🏆🔥

i based this game off a video i saw LOL. it was like these kids playing the same game but one kid kept getting slapped cause he kept guessing the same person over and over again.
